correctness.rationale: Even row permutations act transitively on k-rook row assignments for k<=3 and in two parity orbits for k=4,5 with no simplex inversion; quotient cellular boundaries are signed deletions. Unimodular u/v change yields H3=coker([U R]) on 4-subsets with 5-/6-subset incidence relations. Independently rebuilt integer Smith matrices at n=5..8: free H3 ranks 4,9,14,14; n7 torsion [3], n8 [3,3,3,3,3,3,6]; corresponding free H4 ranks 0,1,6,21. A full two-skeleton and primitive H2-killing maps imply 2-connected CW complex, whose 4-cell attaching maps are classified by integer matrices up to homotopy, giving stated Moore and sphere wedges. The conclusion is strictly for n<=8, not a claimed infinite cutoff.
